about: The radio's stations. The game downloads each station's episodes by itself, over Wi-Fi, into a folder per station beside the saves, and plays them in order. To add a station, add an entry: its name (what the game shows), and where its episodes come from: an Internet Archive item ("archive", all its audio, or the "episodes" chosen from it by "file"), a podcast feed ("rss"), or "episodes" with a "url" each. "n" is an episode's number in the show; the game plays by it.

stations.name: Radio Kafr El-Sheikh
stations.source: Mohamed Andeel's show (2012-2017), as a fan archived it; aired order from TheTVDB; حلقة عبكويم is not in its list, so it has no number and plays last. Episodes 1, 3-7, 10, 11, 18, 27 and 28 are not in the archive.
